records.jp: こころって体育の授業好きだった？
records.en_original: Were you a fan of PE, Kokoro?
records.en: Were you a fan of PE, Kokoro?

records.jp: うん。体動かすの、好きだったから
records.en_original: Yeah. I love anything that lets me move around.
records.en: Yeah. I love anything that lets me move around.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんは？　好きな種目とか、あった？
records.en_original: What about you, Ao? Did you have a favorite thing to do in PE?
records.en: What about you, Ao-chan? Did you have a favorite thing to do in PE?

records.jp: ドッジボールかな！
records.en_original: Dodgeball!
records.en: Dodgeball!

records.jp: わたし、授業ではやったことないかも。<CR>小学生の時は休み時間にやってたなあ
records.en_original: I don't think I ever actually had dodgeball during class, but we played a lot at recess.
records.en: I don't think I ever actually had dodgeball<CR>during class, but we played a lot at recess.

records.jp: わたし、避けるの苦手だったから……。<CR>すぐに外野行きだったけど
records.en_original: I was never any good at dodging. I always ended up on the sidelines right away...
records.en: I was never any good at dodging. I always ended up<CR>on the sidelines right away...

records.jp: 私も、対戦相手だったら真っ先にこころを狙うかも
records.en_original: If you were on the other team, I'd probably aim for you right away too.
records.en: If you were my opponent, I might target you first too, Kokoro.

records.jp: えー、ひどいよ愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: You're so mean, Ao!
records.en: You're so mean, Ao-chan!

records.jp: うそうそ。<CR>ふふ、なんか久々にやりたくなってきちゃったな
records.en_original: I'm just kidding. Hehe, I kinda wanna play again now.
records.en: I am kidding.<CR>Hehe, now I want to play again for the first time in ages.

records.jp: ……今からやってみる？
records.en_original: Want to play then?
records.en: Want to play then?

records.jp: 二人じゃドッジボールにならないよ……
records.en_original: Kokoro, you can't play dodgeball with only two people...
records.en: Kokoro, you can't play dodgeball with only two people...

records.jp: 創作ダンスかな！
records.en_original: Dancing!
records.en: Dancing!

records.jp: ああ……そんな授業もあったなあ。<CR>わたしはちょっと苦手……
records.en_original: Oh, we did that too! I was never any good...
records.en: Oh, we did that too!<CR>I was never any good...

records.jp: 人前で踊るのが恥ずかしかったとか？
records.en_original: Were you embarrassed to dance in front of people?
records.en: Were you embarrassed to dance in front of people?

records.jp: ううん。そうじゃなくて……。<CR>みんなの動きに合わせるのがへたっぴだったの
records.en_original: No, that's not it. I could never move in sync with everyone else.
records.en: No, that's not it. I could<CR>never move in sync with everyone else.

records.jp: なんかテンポが合わなくって
records.en_original: Maybe I just can't keep tempo.
records.en: Maybe I just can't keep tempo.

records.jp: あー。こころってザ・マイペースって感じだもんね。<CR>我が道を行く！　っていうか
records.en_original: You do tend to do things at your own pace.
records.en: Ah. You really are the type to move at your own pace, Kokoro.<CR>Like you follow your own path.

records.jp: それもこころのいいところだと思うよ。私は好き
records.en_original: But I like that about you.
records.en: But I like that about you.

records.jp: ……ありがと、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: ...Thank you, Ao.
records.en: ...Thank you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 戦ってる時とかも思うけど、<CR>こころって結構運動神経良いよね
records.en_original: I couldn't help but notice when we were fighting, but you're really athletic, huh, Kokoro.
records.en: I couldn't help but notice when we were fighting,<CR>but you're really athletic, huh, Kokoro.

records.jp: なんかスポーツやってた？
records.en_original: Did you play a lot of sports when you were younger?
records.en: Did you play a lot of sports when you were younger?

records.jp: えっと、一時期空手を習ってたよ
records.en_original: I did used to do karate.
records.en: I did used to do karate.

records.jp: へえ、空手かあ
records.en_original: Ooh, karate, huh?
records.en: Ooh, karate, huh?

records.jp: 実は私も、合気道習ってたよ。<CR>まあ、親に習わされてただけだけど
records.en_original: I actually used to do aikido. Well, more like my parents made me do it.
records.en: I actually learned aikido too.<CR>Though it was really just because my parents made me.

records.jp: 合気道って、なんか不思議な力で<CR>相手をやっつけちゃうやつ？
records.en_original: Oh, isn't that the martial art where you use magic or something?
records.en: Is aikido the one where you defeat your opponent<CR>with some kind of mysterious power?

records.jp: いや、そんな不思議なもんでもないよ。<CR>相手の力を利用して投げたりするの
records.en_original: Oh, no. It's all about using your opponents momentum against them to through them.
records.en: No, there is nothing that mysterious about it.<CR>You use the opponent’s force to throw them.

records.jp: へえ……見てみたい
records.en_original: Interesting... Can I see it?
records.en: Interesting... Can I see it?

records.jp: いやー、もう昔のことだから型とか忘れちゃった
records.en_original: Ahhh, it's been so long I don't know if I remember much.
records.en: Ahhh, it's been so long I don't know if I remember much.

records.jp: そっかー……残念
records.en_original: Aww... That's too bad.
records.en: Aww... That's too bad.

records.jp: じゃあ、瓦割りとかできる？<CR>空手と言えば瓦割ってるイメージなんだけど
records.en_original: Can you break tiles then? That's what I think of when I hear karate.
records.en: Can you break tiles then?<CR>That's what I think of when I hear karate.

records.jp: いや、あれってパフォーマンスだし……<CR>一般人は普通やらないよ
records.en_original: No, that's just a performance thing. Most people don't do stuff like that.
records.en: No, that is a performance...<CR>Ordinary practitioners do not normally do it.

records.jp: なんだ、そうなんだ
records.en_original: Oh, darn.
records.en: Oh, darn.

records.jp: わたしがやっても、一枚くらいしか割れないと思う
records.en_original: I could probably only break one if I tried.
records.en: I could probably only break one if I tried.

records.jp: （一枚割れるだけですごいと思うけど……）
records.en_original: (Breaking one is pretty amazing in its own right...)
records.en: (Breaking one is pretty amazing in its own right...)

records.jp: せっかくだし、ちょっと遊んでこうよ。<CR>バドミントンとか、バスケとか
records.en_original: Why don't we play for a bit? A game of badminton or basketball, maybe?
records.en: Since we are here, let us play for a while.<CR>Badminton or basketball, perhaps.

records.jp: うん、もちろん
records.en_original: Yeah, of course!
records.en: Yeah, of course!

records.jp: はあ……ふう。結構白熱しちゃったね
records.en_original: Whew... That was an exciting game!
records.en: Whew... That was an exciting game!

records.jp: あはは、いっぱい汗かいちゃった
records.en_original: Haha, I'm totally drenched.
records.en: Haha, I'm totally drenched.

records.jp: ここまできたら、とことん汗だくになろう！<CR>もうひとゲーム！
records.en_original: We've come this far, let's sweat all our worries out! Up for another game?
records.en: We have come this far, so let us get thoroughly drenched in sweat!<CR>One more game!

records.jp: ふふ、いいよ
records.en_original: Hehe, sure thing.
records.en: Hehe, sure thing.

records.jp: 疲れて動けなくなるまで、とことん遊ぼ
records.en_original: We'll go until we can't move anymore!
records.en: We'll go until we can't move anymore!

records.jp: そろそろ切り上げてシャワー浴びにいこっかー
records.en_original: Let's wrap up and go take a shower.
records.en: Let's wrap up and go take a shower.

records.jp: そうだね、賛成
records.en_original: Yeah, good idea.
records.en: Yeah, good idea.

records.jp: また遊ぼうね、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Let's do this again soon.
records.en: Let's play again, Ao-chan.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
